build_cogvideox_training_args: build a CogVideoX training argument parser with model, dataset, training, validation, optimizer, and configuration options
create_model_args_parser: create an argument parser for CogVideoX pretrained model path, revision, variant, and cache directory settings
configure_dataset_args: configure dataset arguments for video training data root, CSV file, caption column, and frame bucketing

run_validation_args: run validation argument configuration for CogVideoX including validation prompts, images, sampling guidance scale, and checkpointing
